producing_agent.identity: Claude Fable 5 (Cursor agent, under J. Brown direction)

hypothesis: Generator episodes form a border, not a one-off: the cube macro shows the same two-ledger shape as the banked sq episode — screens invariant on the shared universe, access changed, round trip identity — with min sizes predicted in advance (5 vs 2 for x^3 at bound 5; the sq replay must give 7 vs 3 for x^4 at bound 7).
decision: Accept border_consolidated if both episodes are outside facts. Accept border_sharpened if exactly one reduces to screen motion. Otherwise inconclusive. Any recorded verdict passes CI.

gates.GEN_SPECIFIED: Episode table with predictions written before enumeration.
gates.GEN_SHARED_UNIVERSES: Base trees embed in extended trees, both episodes.
gates.GEN_REGISTERED_MINS: Observed min sizes equal predictions, both episodes.
gates.GEN_ROUND_TRIPS: Delete then re-adjoin restores the access table, both episodes.
gates.GEN_RANKING_RECORDED: Verdict is one of the three registered outcomes.
gates.GEN_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: No representability kill, no continuum, no LLM.

kill_criteria.GEN_REGISTERED_MINS: Kill the instrument if a predicted min size is wrong; the predictions are the point.
kill_criteria.sq_anchor: Kill the instrument if the sq replay disagrees with door 2's banked numbers.
kill_criteria.border_claim: The border claim dies if the cube episode's access change tracks a moving screen (border_sharpened) or if screens and access both freeze (inconclusive).

audit_card.target_object: Door 2's registered next test: a second generator episode through the same two ledgers.
audit_card.decision: border_consolidated / border_sharpened / inconclusive by the registered rule.
audit_card.representation: Trees to bound 7 over {x, ×, sq} (multiplier 2) and to bound 5 over {x, ×, cube} (multiplier 3); exponent semantics; screens q_den, q_size, q_depth; targets x^4 and x^3.
audit_card.data_clock: None. Exhaustive enumeration, no sampling, no LLM.
material_assumptions: Node-count size measure; mul-only formulas need 2k−1 nodes for x^k.
The sq episode is a replay anchor, not new evidence.
The registered screens are the door-2 three.

objects.episode: (macro m with exponent multiplier, size bound S, target k, predicted mins)
objects.ledgers: screen partitions on the shared universe vs (min size, mass) per grammar

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: Sizes are node counts. Exponents are naturals. cube multiplies the exponent by 3; sq by 2.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: For cube at bound 5, target x^3: min size 5 (base, = 2·3−1) vs 2 (cube(x)); mass 2 vs 3; q_den/q_size/q_depth partitions of the 4 shared trees identical; round trip identity. For sq at bound 7, target x^4: exactly the door-2 numbers (7 vs 3, 5 vs 14).
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Universal over both episodes and all enumerated trees; existential for each access separation.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Registered bounds and targets; no other macros.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: The consolidated border is identified as: generator-set motion carries access facts; screen motion carries representability facts. Two instances of the same two-point separation.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Door 2 (delete_repair_reduction). US-2/US-3. The mul-only min-size formula 2k−1 (every leaf is x, L leaves give exponent L and size 2L−1).
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Screens are label-free functions of the tree; the embedding is the identity on shared trees.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: Bound 5 is the smallest where both x^3 witnesses exist for cube. If a predicted min were wrong the instrument dies rather than reinterpreting.

compute.sampling: Exhaustive enumeration (9+89 trees at bound 7; 4+9 trees at bound 5). No sampling.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as: two generator episodes, same border — access facts move with the generator set while all registered (q, K) data is invariant. Not a kill of the representability reading. Not continuum. Not an LLM. Not Paper G.
